description: Exploited-vulnerability search — ranked KEV. Filtered search over the Ni Biashara cybersecurity shelf's ranked CISA KEV set: known-exploited vulnerabilities joined with EPSS exploitation probability and triage-ranked. Filter by text, vendor, product, priority band, ransomware linkage or EPSS floor. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

band.description: priority band: act_now, urgent or watch (optional)

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

min_epss.description: only records with an EPSS score at or above this floor, 0 to 1 (optional)

q.description: free text over vendor, product, vulnerability name and description (optional)

vendor.description: vendor name text, e.g. PHP Group (optional)

name: search_cyber_kev
title: Exploited-vulnerability search — ranked KEV
